_about: ElevenLabs text-to-sound (eleven_text_to_sound_v2, prompt influence 0.3), flow mYkPiV4IeYKlQ7Dutx3M. Letters = take order in each folder.

swipe.prompt: Fast smooth air whoosh, clean premium transition swish, close-mic, short

impact.prompt: Deep cinematic boom impact, punchy low hit with short dark tail

riser.prompt: Short cinematic tension riser, airy reverse swell building up and cutting off sharply

send.prompt: Smartphone message sent sound, short soft swoosh, clean modern UI

receive.prompt: Soft message received notification, gentle glassy blip, modern phone UI

pop.prompt: Small soft bubble pop, clean UI pop sound, close-mic

key.prompt: Single mechanical keyboard key press, crisp close-mic click

toggle.prompt: Plastic toggle switch flicked on, crisp short click

lock.prompt: Small metal padlock snapping shut, crisp mechanical click

check.prompt: Soft success chime, bright positive UI confirmation ding, short

notify.prompt: Warm marimba notification chime, two quick rising notes, pleasant phone alert

scribble.prompt: Marker pen quickly writing a short word on paper, close-mic scribble
scribble.prompt_b: Felt marker writing a handwritten sentence on paper for two seconds, steady close-mic strokes

swish.prompt: Quick light swish of a paper card sliding past, soft airy whoosh, very short

buzz.prompt: Soft dull error buzz, short low negative UI sound

shimmer.prompt: Soft magical sparkle shimmer, light glittering twinkle, elegant reveal

scramble.prompt: Subtle digital data processing chatter, soft fast computer bleeps and glitches

click.prompt: Finger tapping a smartphone glass screen, single soft tap

hit.prompt: Punchy cinematic hit with a sharp snappy crack, tight trailer impact, no long tail
